articles.author: Percy Allen
articles.title: Storm co-owner suspended, Sophie Cunningham comments after fan incident - The Seattle Times
articles.description: The WNBA suspended Storm minority co-owner Celeste Keaton and fined the team an undisclosed amount following an incident during Tuesday’s game in which she confronted two fans.
